Introduction
This document outlines the equipment 
 inspection I1, which must be carried out every three years as indicated by 
 Y3 in the title block
Test's of voltage transformer types HK 
220 as follows:
Insulation resistance test for primary winding.
Insulation resistance test for secondary winding.
Turn's ratio test.
Capacity and dissipation factor.
Testing of sample oil.

The first draft initiated and 
tested by eng. Khaled Ebrahim, approved by eng. Ramadan Ragab general 
director, accepted by eng. Khairy Eshak Head Sector, certified by eng. 
Ahmed Said Abd El Aziz quality control director, MPIS ME zone Coordinator.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Maintenance staff should be will trained and qualified or directly 
 supervised by some one who is.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area 
 is required.
Wear your 
 safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, breathing mask, 
 safety glass ...etc
Tools and Equipment
1000 volt megger
Turn's ratio equipment
Tan (δ) equipment (TCB 100)
Breale down voltage equipment
